metaTitle: Let’s see how it would look
title: Let’s see how it would look
intro: Three example portfolios built for a {risk, select, Low {Low} Medium {Medium} High {High} other {{risk}}} risk profile, from a versioned rules table. Each line explains where its weight comes from.
label: Teaching example, not advice

amount.label: Fictitious amount
amount.help: Between {min} and {max}. No real money is used.

existing.title: You already have a simulated portfolio
existing.body: It holds {count, plural, one {# position} other {# positions}}. You can keep it and move on to the strategy, or replace it with one of these examples.

notAdjusted: Base table, no adjustment for your profile.
replaceConfirm: The current simulated portfolio will be set aside (nothing is erased, it stays in the log). Confirm?
skippedLines: {count, plural, one {# line could not be placed} other {# lines could not be placed}}: {symbols}.

error.generic: Creating the portfolio failed. Try again in a moment.

figures.title: Risk over the snapshot
figures.note: The example’s weights applied to the snapshot’s past prices, without dividends. This is not a forecast.
figures.unavailable: Risk figures not available for this option.
